title: direction
description: The record of ONE researcher decision: what it decided, why, and what it expects to happen. Its `cause` is the researcher.visited event of the visit. Island changes that carry the decision out (island.created / island.updated / island.joined) are separate events whose `cause` is this direction's id. Several directions can be live at once. Code, not the model, later marks each prediction met / missed / open from events; that is the decision log. Subject is bench:<name>.

brief.description: The decision in prose, addressed to the lab assistants. Specific and falsifiable: name the change, why it should help, and when it nets out. Example: 'Shrink the table to 2^10 and add one Newton step; this only pays if the refinement stays under ~400 Toffolis.'

why.description: The evidence the decision rests on, citing what was observed (island trends, attempt counts, failures). Lets a later reader judge whether the reasoning held.

prediction.description: A checkable expectation, evaluated by code. Example: {metric: 'island_best_cost', island: 'marsyas', threshold: 118000, by_attempts: 300} is met if island marsyas's best verified cost falls below 118,000 within 300 attempt.announced events in that island after this direction, and missed if 300 such attempts pass without it. For metric 'bench_best_cost' set island to null; attempts are then counted across all islands.

metric.description: What is measured: the best verified cost of one island, or of the whole benchmark.

island.description: Island id for island_best_cost; null for bench_best_cost.

threshold.description: Value the metric must fall below (lower cost is better).

by_attempts.description: Number of attempt.announced events (in that island, or all islands for bench_best_cost) after this direction within which the threshold must be reached.

islands.description: Islands this decision concerns, if any.
